item.title: Dangerous road repairs, 21st September
item.description:
Following Severn Trent recent works on Kingsley Gardens the already very poor, broken up surface was worsened. This has now had some patches of tarmac repair which are of a dreadful quality and have left large raised edges that are dangerous to walk and cycle over. They also look an eyesore.

item.title: With regards to the land at Pavegrove lane play area, at the back of our house 125 park avenue, there is a conker tree, which is on your land overhanging into our garden. this wouldn't normally be an issue however, we have two young dogs and as you may not be aware, conkers are toxic to dogs, and one of them got hold of one today and started eating it. We would appreciate this conker tree be cut back to avoid this from happening as this is not our tree, but on council land and the responsibly falls to you. If this is not done in a timely manner, any vet visits that are needed due to either dog eating conkers will be invoiced and sent to you. we would also appreciate all the the brambles that are also on your land, be cut back as they are pulling our back fencing down ., 21st September
item.description:
